description: This file defines a centralized API client for interacting with backend REST endpoints of a web application. It includes functions for authentication, fetching user data, categories, flashcards, quizzes, and statistics. The file primarily contains type definitions, request handling logic, and exported API methods.

methods.description: Generic function to perform HTTP requests to backend endpoints, handling JSON parsing and error responses.

methods.name: api.register
methods.description: Submits user registration data to the backend.

methods.name: api.login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password.

methods.name: api.categories
methods.description: Retrieves list of categories from the backend.

methods.name: api.flashcards
methods.description: Fetches flashcard data based on optional filters such as query, category, type, and direction.

methods.name: api.createQuiz
methods.description: Creates a new quiz with specified size, category, type, and direction.

methods.name: api.submitQuiz
methods.description: Submits answers for a given quiz and returns the score and details.

methods.name: api.getQuiz
methods.description: Retrieves the results of a specific quiz.

methods.name: api.statsOverview
methods.description: Fetches overview statistics for user progress, including daily reviews, accuracy, and heatmap data.
